site.name: Addule Shaft
site.location: Central City quadrangle / near Russell Gulch
overview: Addule Shaft is a documented inactive gold-mine and shaft locality in Clear Creek County, preserved as a named feature on Central City-area topographic mapping.
moreHistory: USGS-derived mapping places Addule Shaft Mine near 39.761932, -105.517497 at about 9,157 feet elevation. The mapped mine location identifies the historic site; no claim is made that a surviving shaft collar, headframe, or other surface structure has been field-verified or is accessible today.
